# Singapore fixtures

Two unmodified weekly files from the Energy Market Authority of Singapore, used by `tests/test_singapore.py`:
`20221226.xls` (holds 1 Jan 2023, a Sunday) and `20230102.xls`.

Contains information from Half-hourly System Demand Data accessed on 2026-10-03 from the Energy Market
Authority of Singapore, which is made available under the terms of the Singapore Open Data Licence
version 1.0 (https://www.ema.gov.sg/terms-of-use).
